message.content: Releases keep surprising people. A fix merges on Tuesday and nobody knows it shipped until the changelog shows up.

Let's adopt changesets. Every PR that changes user-facing behavior adds a markdown file under .changeset describing the bump, the release workflow assembles those into the changelog, and npm publish happens off main.
And the version bump itself? I don't want maintainers hand-editing package.json.
The changesets action opens an automated version PR that consumes the pending changeset files and bumps the version. Merging that PR to main is what triggers the publish workflow.
